ListSql:
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[ID]) AS [ID], [c].[Name], [c].[IntegrationId], CASE
    WHEN [c].[CountryID] IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[CountryID])
END AS [CountryID], CASE
    WHEN [c].[RegionID] IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[RegionID])
END AS [RegionID], [c].[DisplayOrder], [c].[IsDeleted], [r].[Name] AS [Region], CASE
    WHEN [r].[ID] IS NOT NULL AND [c0].[ID] IS NOT NULL THEN [c0].[Name]
END AS [Country], CASE
    WHEN [r].[ID] IS NOT NULL AND [c0].[ID] IS NOT NULL THEN [c0].[DisplayOrder]
END AS [CountryDisplayOrder], [r].[DisplayOrder] AS [RegionDisplayOrder]
FROM [ShiftIdentity].[Cities] AS [c]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Regions] AS [r] ON [c].[RegionID] = [r].[ID]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Countries] AS [c0] ON [r].[CountryID] = [c0].[ID]
